props.name: items
props.description: Card faces. A string is shown as an image URL.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one card to travel from the center to the edge.

props.name: direction
props.description: `out` comes toward you from the center, `in` goes away into it.

props.name: spread
props.description: Distance from the center to each wall, as a share of the width.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far back the walls meet, in frame widths.

props.name: angle
props.description: How far cards on the walls turn toward the middle, in degrees.

props.name: bend
props.description: Share of the trip spent fanning out from the center to the wall.

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Size and shape of every card.
